```python
import pandas as pd
import seaborn as sns
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

# Load the dataset
df = pd.read_csv('data/titanic.csv')

# Set the style
sns.set(style="whitegrid")

# Create a figure and axis
plt.figure(figsize=(10, 6))

# Create a bar plot for survival rate by passenger class
sns.barplot(x='pclass', y='survived', data=df, ci=None, palette='pastel')

# Add title and labels
plt.title('Survival Rate by Passenger Class', fontsize=16)
plt.xlabel('Passenger Class', fontsize=12)
plt.ylabel('Survival Rate', fontsize=12)

# Save the plot as a PNG file
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
```
